field.name: ga_military_exemption_62_to_64
field.comment: Georgia retirement income exclusion cap at age 62-64 (or under 62 and permanently disabled): $35,000, covering taxable pensions including military retired pay plus up to $5,000 of earned income. Form 500 Schedule 1 line 7a; O.C.G.A. 48-7-27(a)(5); 2025 IT-511 p. 20-21. The military exclusion on line 7b is for taxpayers under 62 only.

field.name: ga_military_exemption_65_plus
field.comment: Georgia retirement income exclusion cap at age 65 or older: $65,000 per taxpayer, covering taxable pensions including military retired pay plus up to $5,000 of earned income. Form 500 Schedule 1 line 7a; O.C.G.A. 48-7-27(a)(5); 2025 IT-511 p. 20-21.

field.name: ga_military_exemption_under_62_base
field.comment: Georgia military retirement income exclusion for a taxpayer under 62: up to $17,500, plus an additional $17,500 when Georgia earned income exceeds $17,500. Form 500 Schedule 1 line 7b; O.C.G.A. 48-7-27(a)(5.1); 2025 IT-511 p. 20-21.

field.name: ga_military_exemption_under_62_earned_threshold
field.comment: GA earned income threshold for additional exemption under age 62 (2025)

field.name: ga_military_retirement_exemption
field.comment: Georgia exclusion of military retired pay, computed per taxpayer by GA_Retirement_Income_Exclusion: under 62, the military retirement exclusion (Schedule 1 line 7b); 62 and over, the retirement income exclusion (line 7a) counting the pay as a taxable pension and up to $5,000 of wages as earned income (#1330).

field.name: ga_military_retirement_taxable
field.comment: GA taxable military retirement after exemption (computed)

field.name: ga_retirement_exclusion_earned_income_cap
field.comment: Georgia retirement income exclusion (Form 500 Schedule 1 line 7a): up to $5,000 of the maximum exclusion may be earned income (2025 IT-511 Schedule 1 worksheet lines 4-5).

field.name: ga_tax_rate
field.comment: Georgia flat income tax rate 5.19% effective January 1, 2025 (HB 111; 2025 IT-511 What is New; Form 500 line 16). Was 5.39% for 2024.
